DWES.HirelingRollTrigger: When a hireling finds themselves in a dangerous, degrading, or just flat-out crazy situation due to your orders, roll +Loyalty.
DWES.HirelingRollSuccess: They stand firm and carry out the order.
DWES.HirelingRollPartial: They do it for now, but come back with serious demands later. Meet them or the hireling quits on the worst terms.
DWES.HirelingRollFailure: They refuse, panic, or make things worse.
DWES.HirelingRollNoResult: No Dungeon World roll result matches this total.
